name: Calendar
description: The family's calendars in one place. Each person chooses what the household sees: nothing, busy times only, or the details.
author: Marc Montecalvo

provides.description: Calendar sources, such as Google and Microsoft 365

extends.description: Calendar tools for agents that were given this add-on

config.label: Calendar connector address
config.help: The HTTPS address where the Calendar service runs, for example https://calendar.example.org.

config.label: Link calendar accounts
config.help: Each person links their own Google or Microsoft 365 account and chooses what the household may see.
